title: Identify and Analyze Hero Section Container
description: Locate the hero section container in the landing page and analyze its current structure and applied Tailwind CSS classes.
details: Open `app/page.tsx` and identify the JSX element(s) representing the hero section. Review the current Tailwind CSS utility classes applied to the container, noting any padding, margin, height, or width constraints. Check for usage of shadcn/ui components that may affect sizing. Ensure you understand how the hero section fits within the overall page layout.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the hero section in the browser and confirm the current dimensions. Use browser dev tools to verify which classes are applied and if any are being overridden. Document the baseline for comparison after changes.

title: Adjust Hero Section Dimensions Using Tailwind CSS
description: Increase the size of the hero section by modifying Tailwind CSS utility classes on the container element.
details: Edit the hero section container in `app/page.tsx` to increase its visual prominence. Adjust padding (e.g., increase `py-24` to `py-32` or higher), set a larger min-height (e.g., `min-h-[500px]`), and consider increasing max-width if constrained. Apply responsive Tailwind prefixes (e.g., `md:py-48`) to ensure the section scales well across devices. Avoid custom CSS unless necessary.
test_strategy: Reload the landing page and visually confirm the hero section is larger. Use browser dev tools to check the new dimensions. Compare with the baseline. Ensure the section remains visually balanced and does not cause overflow or layout issues.

title: Validate Responsiveness and Cross-Browser Compatibility
description: Test the updated hero section across multiple devices and browsers to ensure the new frame is responsive and visually correct.
details: Manually test the landing page on various viewport sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop) using browser dev tools and real devices if available. Check Chrome, Firefox, and Safari for layout consistency. Ensure the larger hero frame does not push important content below the fold or introduce horizontal scrolling. Adjust Tailwind classes as needed for edge cases.
test_strategy: Perform manual visual checks on all major breakpoints and browsers. Look for overflow, alignment, or clipping issues. Document any issues found and iterate on styling until resolved.

title: Review and Refactor for Design Consistency
description: Ensure the updated hero section aligns with the overall design system and does not conflict with shadcn/ui components or the landing page layout.
details: Review the hero section in the context of the full landing page. Check for consistency in spacing, alignment, and visual hierarchy. If shadcn/ui components are used, ensure their styles are not being unintentionally overridden. Refactor Tailwind classes for clarity and maintainability if needed. Avoid introducing custom CSS unless absolutely necessary.
test_strategy: Compare the updated hero section with other sections for visual harmony. Solicit feedback from a designer or team member if available. Confirm that the hero section remains accessible and visually appealing.
